3cc12a6767: The Taichung City open data platform gathers open data and geospatial imagery from every city agency. Its front-end source code is published as public code, as a reference for industry, government and academia.
0cbac3592f: "Runner's Station - friendly exercise map", a demonstration project from moda's Civic Technology Pilot Field programme, built by MW RUN TEAM. Lets users create, browse and join running or group-training events, with map visualisation, event cards, detail pages and a creation interface. A demonstrator, not yet in production.
849841b83d: Online waiting-list lookup for children's early-intervention joint assessment clinics (front end). A moda Civic Technology Pilot Field demonstrator built by OneStep MAP with Taoyuan City's Women and Children's Bureau, letting parents check hospital waiting numbers in real time. A demonstrator, not yet in production.
09e3e60c36: Online waiting-list lookup for children's early-intervention joint assessment clinics (back end). Adds a management interface for hospital case managers to update waiting numbers and a query back office for bureau staff. A demonstrator, not yet in production.
5fe1fedffd: Disaster-data consolidation system (back end), from moda's 2025 Civic Technology Pilot Field, built with Tainan City's Smart Development Centre. City departments upload preliminary disaster statistics as spreadsheets; AI converts them to a uniform JSON format and natural-language queries return summaries.
9c6bd20824: Reference handbook on open source software for the public sector. Part of moda's commitment to deepen cross-agency open data and public code, published in 2026 to spread open source knowledge across government bodies.
076a29395c: Public childcare application management system (front end). A 2023 moda Civic Technology Pilot Field demonstrator built by the "Let's Go Together" team with Taichung City's Social Affairs Bureau: an integrated platform for applying, querying, reviewing and administering public childcare places. A demonstrator, not yet in production.
feff4fbbb1: Digital Credential Wallet - issuer and verifier service modules. Built around security and privacy, combining Decentralized Identity (DID) and Verifiable Credentials (VC) so users keep control of their digital documents across storage, authorisation and cross-agency use.
bf7e8ad9f3: Online self-declaration system for fire safety equipment inspection (front end). The public can upload declarations quickly and track case progress; digital handling makes review more efficient.
e758a17b5a: Digital Credential Wallet app SDK. Built around security and privacy, combining Decentralized Identity (DID) and Verifiable Credentials (VC) so users keep control of their digital documents.
b9dc5377ca: Taipei Coding Festival event website. Taipei City's Department of Information Technology has run this open source outreach event since 2023; this is the new event site for publishing information and taking registrations, deployed to the cloud and released as open source to sustain the public code effort.
2c566b7c4b: Tainan dengue-prevention field digital tool (front end). A 2023 moda Civic Technology Pilot Field demonstrator built with Tainan City's Health Bureau to simplify dengue control workflows, replacing cumbersome manual verification with more timely information.
d53456b1cc: Tainan flood shelter alerts and routing. Built at the 2024 AI Tainan Digital City Governance Hackathon after Typhoon Gaemi's levee overflow blocked evacuation routes: combines shelter data with crowd-reported road conditions to find passable evacuation routes during a disaster.
53e8e9e77b: Digital business card. An open source NFC card system built by moda in July 2025 on a privacy-first design: personal data is stored on the NFC card itself rather than a back-end server, with a pure front-end architecture and layered protections including DOMPurify.
10055c3745: Address standardisation API. Converts addresses to a standard form and splits them into components (city, district, road, number and floor) to support matching and analysis. Part of the Ministry of the Interior's address identifier scheme - a 7-digit serial plus check digit acting as an address ID.
d75d6774ac: City Pass architecture. Taipei City's Department of Information Technology is generalising its "Taipei Pass" experience into an open source City Pass: a baseline application architecture for government agencies, with interface design informed by policy and public feedback.
adcc91eff2: City Pass services. Taipei City is open-sourcing the City Pass service modules so others can reuse them, simplifying development and improving administrative efficiency.
826a491985: Disaster impact assessment platform. Built at the 2024 AI Tainan hackathon by Tainan's Hydraulic Engineering Bureau with the "Five More Minutes of Water" civic team: mark polygons on a map (flood extent) and automatically compute area, household and population counts to assess post-disaster impact.
948b4ff775: Public asset management platform (front end). Built at the 2024 AI Tainan hackathon by Tainan's Finance and Tax Bureau with the City Activitas civic team: consolidates records and provides asset lookup, reporting, image upload and report generation.
080ddf928a: Drone search-and-rescue image recognition. Built at the 2024 AI Tainan hackathon with Tainan's Fire Bureau: an RT-DETR model processes aerial footage at the edge to locate targets in water, helping rescuers search faster.
0ac506cfa5: Dynamic template Word document generation. Uses the Poi-tl template engine to generate documents from Word templates, suitable for batch and high-concurrency use such as reports, contracts and invitations. Authors design templates in Word using simple placeholder syntax like {{name}} and {{table}}.
a7ffc9fee2: User action audit logging system. Captures and stores significant actions - logins and logouts, queries, edits, deletions - for transparency and traceability, with flexible reporting so administrators can review activity by user or period for internal audit and compliance.
0b2ee419d4: Electronic official-document package attachment name resolver. The Ministry of Environment returns signed document packages to its budget accounting system, but attachment names are hash strings; this reverses them to the original filenames so accounting staff can identify them.
25a2e72366: Website tamper-detection system. Monitors file directories for unauthorised modification, notifies staff immediately when tampering is detected, and automatically restores the original directory contents.
4cf7176527: Data visualisation website. Example functionality for turning raw data into charts, making complex data easier to read. Includes a front/back-end web framework example and conversion of data into various graph types via Cytoscape.
427cf3c967: File transfer case management system. Centralises automated file transfers so transfer records can be audited and performance measured: it runs registered transfer services, obtains source and destination connection details, downloads from the source file server and uploads automatically to the destination.
a5921e4496: Data validation and secure handling module. Provides back-end validation, masking and conversion for common data types - dates, national ID numbers, business numbers and numeric conversion - to improve accuracy, consistency and security.
f127cdaa91: Open document conversion system. Wraps the open source LibreOffice conversion tools to convert traditional Word, Excel and PDF files into open document formats, and can be built into scheduled batch automation. Handles .docx, .xlsx, .xls and more.
fe17732f94: Multilingual data dictionary system. Provides locale-specific sorting and comparison so developers can process data by the rules of each region (Traditional Chinese, English, German and others), avoiding the errors that arise when collation rules differ between languages.
cd172de951: Dynamic data encoding conversion system. For integrating legacy systems whose fixed-length string output cannot be handled by modern standards such as XML or JSON: parses and converts positional fields, and resolves mismatches caused by differing character encodings and lengths.
220d1aae5c: Encrypted data transfer and storage system. Configurable strong algorithms (for example SHA3-256 or HMAC) protect sensitive information in transit, for use in API request authentication, data signing and related purposes.
ab40de8ff0: Front-end data security framework for web forms. A Vue-based framework for building electronic form systems quickly, handling the tedious parts of form design and field validation.
8906402379: Secure data transfer verification system. Where agencies exchange data through T-Road secure servers, physically isolated internal networks make it hard for engineers to obtain test messages for diagnosis. This service verifies that transfers conform to the interface message specification and API rules inside a closed network.
d20c3a6281: Personal data interface verification system. Uses the MyData platform's transfer verification service as a worked example of secure personal-data handling: request patterns, security token validation and data packaging, covering both message and file transfer formats.
62520c4f55: Green Web site. Results site for moda's 2024 green digital net-zero programme, including a web page carbon calculator, an outcomes section and draft internet sustainability design guidelines.
96d51ec2db: Matrix client (Element series) matrix-react-sdk. Element is open source communication software built on decentralised standards by the Matrix core team; this is the underlying matrix-react-sdk, usable for building other software and for IP-based real-time messaging that can integrate with Slack, Telegram and others.
a668adff59: GOV.UK Forms Admin. GOV.UK Forms is the UK Government Digital Service's public-sector online forms platform; this is the administration software behind it. Agencies can use its templates to build simple external forms, with automatic submission checking and submission tracking.
6a3e5813a7: moda global website. The Ministry of Digital Affairs' website - a full content management system conveying digital development plans and outcomes to the public and to other agencies. Its source was planned as open from the outset so bodies with similar needs can fork it; user-centred by design.
b5b920f070: Lighthouse platform. Uses GitHub Actions to run Lighthouse scans automatically and presents the reports centrally. Lighthouse is an open source tool for improving web page performance, quality and correctness, producing a report and score from a series of tests.
052d090552: Yivi (IRMA). Yivi is an open source identity verification service; this is the app source. Users can disclose different amounts of identity data as needed, with personal data stored on-device encrypted by PIN, enabling passwordless login and document signing.
761eea23aa: GOV.UK Notify. The UK Government Digital Service's public-sector messaging platform for email, SMS and letters; this is the admin interface. Users can edit message templates, track delivery status and send manually or automatically without writing code.
0804b2298d: Government open data platform front end. Open-sourced so government agencies and civic groups have a reference for building open data applications.
c7096cbb36: Public Code Platform. Encourages agencies, industry and the public to use, review and fix the code behind government digital services, promoting exchange between agencies and improving the quality and transparency of public services.
701281639a: publiccode.yml standard. A metadata description standard for public software, easy for developers and non-technical readers alike, intended to make software built by public administrations discoverable.
1541cabd9f: Public Digital Innovation Space (PDIS) blog. A Jekyll static site generator setup producing static HTML from plain markdown, bilingual in Chinese and English.
4c4d772b40: Yivi (IRMA) scheme manager. Yivi is an open source identity verification service; this is the scheme manager source. Users can disclose different amounts of identity data, stored on-device encrypted by PIN, for passwordless login and document signing.
9c58ca0242: publiccode.yml editor. Helps you create and validate a publiccode.yml for your project: fill in a form to generate a standards-compliant YAML file to download or copy into your repository root, or upload an existing file to check and correct it.
b8f43dbfa8: Taipei City Dashboard. Cross-references map layers and data charts, presenting trends across time, space and statistics, and letting users build custom themed pages to follow the city's pulse inside a virtual 3D map.
0ed01b728a: Voluntary greenhouse gas inventory system for the digital industry. Supports Taiwan's 2050 net-zero target through public code and public-private collaboration, led by moda, providing a carbon inventory system others can reuse and lowering the barrier to self-assessment.
dcfe329b71: Standard for Public Code. A standard from the Foundation for Public Code giving government departments and collaborating organisations shared standards and guidance for developing software, so work can be co-developed and reused.
f297fb89f5: Matrix client (Element series) Web. Element is open source communication software built on decentralised standards by the Matrix core team; this is the web client built on matrix-react-sdk, for IP-based real-time messaging that can integrate with Slack, Telegram and others.
56234135c5: GOV.UK Forms Product Pages. GOV.UK Forms is the UK Government Digital Service's public-sector online forms platform; this is its page generator. Agencies can use the platform's templates to build simple external forms with automatic submission checking and tracking.
1d0f3992bd: ODF document tools. Helps public bodies create and retain documents in Open Document Format so government documents can move between agencies. Built on open document software, it edits standard ODF files, supports the full CNS 11643 Chinese character set, and includes a Q&A issue-reporting tool with a support workflow.
